features_shell_tool.label: Shell Tool
features_shell_tool.help: Enable the exec_shell tool to allow executing shell commands.

features_web_search.label: Web Search
features_web_search.help: Enable web_search and compatible alias web.run, defaults to DuckDuckGo.

features_apply_patch.label: Apply Patch
features_apply_patch.help: Enable the apply_patch tool, supporting unified diff format batch modifications.

features_mcp.label: MCP
features_mcp.help: Enable Model Context Protocol support, allowing connections to external MCP servers to extend the toolset.

features_exec_policy.label: Exec Policy
features_exec_policy.help: Enable the execution policy engine to perform permission checks and approval on tool calls.

features_vision_model.label: Vision Model
features_vision_model.help: When enabled, an independent image analysis model can be configured via [vision_model]; requires manual activation.
